title: The benchmark report records the pool's sc_absent and sc_partial figures before and after the false-good fix
goal: kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md gains a section headed with BG-xbbimxpq that gives the pool's sc_absent and sc_partial figures before and after the fix: the free hook arm before (sc_absent 2 of 6, sc_partial 6 of 6 at origin/main 0ae6d30bc, measured at planning) and after, one rep each with --out to a scratch file; the paid arms haiku-5-5, sonnet-5-5 and router at one rep on the same 12 rows after the fix with --max-usd 5 (dry run at planning: $3.51), against their cells of the 2026-10-12 record; benchmarks.py report --check keeps passing

clauses.clause: kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md gains a section headed with BG-xbbimxpq that gives the pool's sc_absent and sc_partial figures before and after the fix: the free hook arm before (sc_absent 2 of 6, sc_partial 6 of 6 at origin/main 0ae6d30bc, measured at planning) and after, one rep each with --out to a scratch file
the paid arms haiku-5-5, sonnet-5-5 and router at one rep on the same 12 rows after the fix with --max-usd 5 (dry run at planning: $3.51), against their cells of the 2026-10-12 record

notes: Premise (planned 2026-10-12): benchmarks.md has no before/after section for BG-xbbimxpq. Before, measured free at origin/main 0ae6d30bc: benchmarks.py run pool --arms hook --kinds sc_absent,sc_partial --reps 1 --out SCRATCH gave sc_absent 2 of 6, sc_partial 6 of 6 (16 s, no model). Paid dry run: run pool --arms haiku-5-5,sonnet-5-5,router --kinds sc_absent,sc_partial --reps 1 --dry-run estimates $3.51 for 60 runs (under the operator's 5 USD limit); run it with --max-usd 5 and --out to scratch, never into the results file. report --check passes before the work and pins the generated tables.
